visualCharacteristics.purpose: Grid of article/adventure teasers: image, title, one-line description, each linking to a detail page

contentPattern.structure: one row per card: image | body (title, description, link); with category-filter-tabs, an optional trailing cell lists categories (comma-separated)

reuseGuidance: Use for teaser grids linking to detail pages. Add the category-filter-tabs option to show a client-side filter bar built from the per-card categories.
